description: Use this when the user wants a new QR code based on one of their existing codes, with a change to its picture, e.g. "more trees" or "make it night time". It makes a new code with its own id and short link that opens the same destination and keeps the original’s style and logo; the original code does not change. It answers at once with the new code’s id while the picture is painted; then call get_qr_code with the id to wait for the image. Only link codes the user owns can be varied. Do not use it to change where a code points or to make an unrelated code. Each variation counts against the user’s QRX allowance.

change.description: What to change in the picture, e.g. "add more trees" or "make it autumn".

id.description: The id of the code to start from.

name: vary_qr_code
